notes.title: New Backstory Animations and Character Background
notes.content: [p]Aloha![/p][p][/p][p]We are excited to announce the addition of more backstory and artwork to the game, including the events leading up to the encounter and choices at the entrance of the Tomb. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45570201/d34a629d84f595c956ac7c7981fa16936b155ccb.png"][/img][/p][p]This includes:[/p][list][*][p]Opening On A Dream[/p][/*][*][p]Awaken in the Prison Cell[/p][/*][*][p]Crossing the Swamp[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45570201/bd3ff85c1b99fd7a66bcee249346ec4fac7f36d6.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45570201/556cad84fed474ae927f4698bfafd6157546c802.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Story Content Has Expanded By More Than Double
notes.content: [p][/p][p][/p][p]New content including dialogue and choices, more than doubling the volume of material[/p][p]in the game. The new areas include:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]     Path of Destiny[/p][/*][*][p]     Mirror of Many Eyes[/p][/*][*][p]     The Verdant Maw[/p][/*][*][p]     The Starless Library[/p][/*][*][p]     Feast of Worms[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Expanded the exploration of character identity and the encounter with the current [/p][p]Dream Weaver.
